notes.title: Full Launch!
notes.content:
We have now uploaded the Space theme puzzles and with that we have reached content complete for this game.

Thank you for everyone who played it in Early Access. We hope even more of you will check it out. We are considering future updates to this game, so please keep the feedback coming as we would love to hear it. 

Remember use right mouse button + scroll wheel to zoom in and out of images.

notes.title: Update Notes for 10/31/24: New Images!
notes.content:
Happy Halloween! 

The nine puzzles for the History theme have been added.

Please remember that you can hold you right mouse button down + scroll wheel to adjust the zoom level.

notes.title: Wonders Added!
notes.content:
9 new images to discover in the Wonders category!

Please remember to hold your right mouse button and scroll with your wheel to zoom in and out of images as you solve them.

notes.title: Update Notes for Sep 23rd
notes.content:
New Animal theme has been added with 9 more levels

Bug fixes

notes.title: Update Notes 9/12/24
notes.content:
Controller support! 
If you are playing on Steam deck you will want to add a custom key binding for right mouse and scroll wheel to be able to zoom in and out.

If you are playing on Keyboard, your manual zoom is Right mouse hold + scroll wheel

Improved soundtrack!
Lengthened our original soundtrack so that there is less looping for a long coloring session

Bug fixes!
Performance, improved visibility of numbers, etc
